::: {.intro}
I'm a financial analyst with experience in corporate valuation, investment research, and management reporting. I am completing an M.Sc. in Business Administration with a focus on Finance at the University of Münster, where my academic work focuses on asset pricing, financial engineering, and empirical capital-markets research. My professional experience spans DCF and comparable-company valuation, portfolio and risk analysis, and data-driven financial reporting at Nestlé Nespresso.

This site presents selected research and analytical projects, including the questions, data, methods, and practical implications behind the results.
:::

### [Do FOMC Statements Move Asset Prices Beyond the Rate Decision?](research/fomc-study.qmd)

::: {.tags}
[Python]{.tag} [NLP]{.tag} [Transformers]{.tag} [Event study]{.tag}
:::

Five text measures of Fed communication, from a hawkishness dictionary to transformer models, tested on 239 FOMC meetings. The policy surprise explains the market move; the wording adds almost nothing.
:::

### [Personality Differences and Investment Decisions](research/personality-investment.qmd)

::: {.tags}

German household panel data (SOEP) on how the Big Five traits shape stock ownership. Openness works almost entirely through risk tolerance, with an inverse-U pattern.
